246428.name: Superior Perennium Blaster
steps: Advanced Hacker Tool (general stores) + Premium Nano-Charged Assault Rifle / Rifle (Rubi-Ka missions) = Hacked Nano-Charged gun. 7x QL Breaking & Entry.
Sheet of Perennium + Spirit Tech Apparatus (Double Barrel / Long Muzzle / Short Muzzle) = the matching Perennium barrel/muzzle. 7x QL Weapon Smithing, 5x QL Mechanical Engineering.
Barrel/muzzle + hacked gun = Half-Finished Perennium weapon; then Perennium Bolts + half-finished = Superior Perennium Blaster / Sniper / Beamer. Same 7x WS / 5x ME.

Sheet of Perennium and Perennium Bolts are common Heckler loot at the brink of any Shadowlands area. Spirit Tech Apparatus is an uncommon drop from Mortiig bosses (Elysium; Penumbra mobs on the Ravine floating island), Named Golems (Adonis), Greek bosses in Scheol and Hecklers in Inferno.

Endgame version: Perennium <type> Rebuild Kit (reward from a Spirit Quest in Inferno) + the matching Beast weapon (Soldier: Lord of Anger; Fixer: Lord of Envy; Agent: Lord of Angst) = an activated kit, then activated kit + QL200 Superior Perennium weapon = Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon. No skill required. The gain is a much higher max beneficial skill; damage and requirements are unchanged.
Blaster = Soldier, Beamer = Fixer, Sniper = Agent. QL range 50-200.

254478.name: Kyr'Ozch Rifle - Type 2
254478.where: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump)
steps: Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets.
Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>.

The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest.

Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared.

Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published.

Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.
254478.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'AlienInvasion' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from soldier-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Kyr'Ozch Rifle - Type 2').

264884.name: Ofab Silverback Mk 4
264884.where: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub
steps: Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220.

Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance.

Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun).

The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps.
No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol.
264884.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'LostEden' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from soldier-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Ofab Silverback Mk 4').

267125.name: Dreadloch Thrasher
steps: Dreadloch weapons are a DIRECT DROP from the Dreadloch camp bosses, not a tradeskill. They are QL300 only and require the Lost Eden expansion to wield (from the item's own Expansion(389) criterion).

There are two sets of five camps, one per side. Omni-side camps (the CLAN quest chain, started by Captain Cante Hawke in Old Athens): Clondyke - Force Recon Commander 191; Eastern Foul Plains - Special Agent Moxy; Pleasant Meadows - Major Woon; Southern Artery Valley - Assault Commander Pax; Upper Stret East Bank - Peal Thunder.

Clan-side camps (the OMNI quest chain, started by Paolo Turin near the Grid terminal in Omni-1 Trade 409x542, who sends you to Sergeant Jasmine Cordell in Omni-1 Entertainment 906x629): Belial Forest 3184x503 - Brigadier Crux; Athen Shire / War Academy 1720x1920 - Assault Commander Sleek; The Longest Road / Drumdar 3650x574 - Chief Gunner Kyle Swan; Broken Shores 2240x4765 - Special Agent Deko; Upper Stret East Bank / Safe Haventown 1798.6x2207.0 - Carillion Thunder.

The bosses have a 2-hour respawn and the corpse can be looted for 29 minutes before it rots. The quest is NOT required to claim the loot - completing it adds a merit token worth +50 side tokens and +500 Victory Points.

The same bosses also drop high-quality Kyr'Ozch clumps for Ofab upgrades, Hellfyre Magma Suit armour, the merit/combat board bases and the Dreadloch utility items (Damage Amplifier, Endurance Booster, Sniper's Friend, Stab Guidance System, Survival Predictor).
No per-weapon drop rate is published on either allowed source.
267125.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'LostEden' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from soldier-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Dreadloch Thrasher').

302941.name: Corrupted Lord of Greed
302941.where: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220)
steps: A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015).

Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores.

Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn.

Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6.
The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed.
No per-boss drop rates are published.
302941.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'LegacyOfTheXan' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from soldier-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Corrupted Lord of Greed').
